title: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling in Apache James Mime4J library prior version 0.8.15 allows Denial…
description: A resource allocation vulnerability exists in the Apache James Mime4J library prior to version 0.8.15 that can lead to denial of service when parsing MIME messages. The issue is addressed in MIME4J version 0.8.15, which is included in Apache James server 3.9.1.
